run_fastplane: run fastplane to render depth, transmittance, and features from triplane or voxel grid representations along camera rays
run_fastplane_naive: run fastplane_naive as a reference CPU implementation to compute expected depth and color from sampled points along rays
run_fastplane_eval_mlp: run fastplane_eval_mlp to evaluate the MLP that maps 3D samples to opacity values and color features using triplane or voxel grid inputs
create_fastplane_function: create a FastplaneFunction autograd wrapper that integrates forward and backward Triton kernels for differentiable triplane rendering
create_fastplane_shape_representation: create FastplaneShapeRepresentation and FastplaneActivationFun enums to configure triplane versus voxel grid and softplus versus relu activation modes
